proof_body:
by
  intro P m n hn hc hr
  obtain ⟨r, hrdef⟩ : ∃ r : ℚ, r = (m : ℚ) / n := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hrdef] at hr
  have hnum := num_dvd_of_is_root (A := ℤ) (K := ℚ) hr
  have hden := den_dvd_of_is_root (A := ℤ) (K := ℚ) hr
  have hmk := IsFractionRing.mk'_num_den' ℤ r
  have hd0 : (IsFractionRing.den ℤ r : ℤ) ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero _
  have hn' : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hd' : ((IsFractionRing.den ℤ r : ℤ) : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hd0
  have hcross : IsFractionRing.num ℤ r * n = m * (IsFractionRing.den ℤ r : ℤ) := by
    have h1 : ((IsFractionRing.num ℤ r : ℤ) : ℚ) / ((IsFractionRing.den ℤ r : ℤ) : ℚ) = (m : ℚ) / n := by
      rw [← hrdef]
      simpa using hmk
    rw [div_eq_div_iff hd' hn'] at h1
    exact_mod_cast h1
  constructor
  · exact (hc.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (Dvd.intro _ hcross.symm)).trans hnum
  · exact (hc.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left (Dvd.intro_left _ hcross)).trans hden
target_source: ∀ (P : Polynomial ℤ) (m n : ℤ), n ≠ 0 → IsCoprime m n → Polynomial.aeval ((m : ℚ) / n) P = 0 → m ∣ P.coeff 0 ∧ n ∣ P.leadingCoeff
